method: Asking prices of every home listed as on sale on berkeleygroup.co.uk (all Berkeley Group brands) in developments within 35 km of the site; floor area = developer's published square footage x 0.092903; ppm2 = asking price / m². Locations from the development postcode (postcodes.io).
caveats: Asking prices, not achieved prices: Berkeley offers incentives (e.g. 'Own New Rate Reducer', contributions to costs) that are not deducted here.

Published square footage is the developer's marketing internal area (flats: net internal area; houses: usually gross internal area including stairs) - close to, but not the same as, the GIA/NIA in the Ravensbourne Place planning schedule.
Only homes still unsold are listed, so the sample is skewed to what has not sold yet (often the higher floors / dearer plots, or the remnants of a phase).
Almost all nearby Berkeley stock is apartments in regeneration schemes; houses on sale are few (Kidbrooke Village townhouses, Foal Hurst Green in Paddock Wood).
Inner-London schemes (Oval, Bermondsey, Wapping, Canary Wharf...) carry central-London pricing and are kept out of the 'comparable' summary.

summary.comparable_rule: Outer London (>= 9 km from Charing Cross) within 20 km of the site, or Kent/Surrey within 35 km.

web_notes.text: Year to 30 April 2026: 4,076 homes completed across London and the South East at an average selling price of £546,000, down 7.9% from £593,000 the year before (results of 24 June 2026). Group-wide mix, mostly London apartments - context only.

web_notes.topic: Foal Hurst Green (Paddock Wood) - achieved new-build prices, first phase
web_notes.text: HM Land Registry Price Paid, Juno Street TN12 6FU (an agent listing confirms Juno Street is Berkeley's Foal Hurst Green, 2021 build; 4 Juno Street = 3-bed semi of ~1,019 sq ft / 94.7 m²): 11 new-build sales Oct 2021 - Apr 2022 - semis £445,000-£459,000 (No. 4: £445,000 = ~£4,700/m²), terraces £437,600-£515,500, detached £505,000-£680,000 (median £666,250). Today's asking prices for 3-bed semis at the same scheme (1,133-1,136 sq ft) are £575,000-£600,000 (~£5,450-£5,700/m²).

web_notes.topic: Kidbrooke Village (Greenwich SE3) - agent price guidance
web_notes.text: Benhams new-homes page (updated October 2026) quotes Kidbrooke Village from £375,000 (1 bed), £525,000 (2 bed), £650,000 (3 bed) and £1,100,000 (4 bed); the Blackheath Collection townhouses are 4-bed, 1,515 sq ft (141 m²) at £1,110,000. Zoopla's new-homes listings show the Pegler Square townhouses at £1,100,000-£1,110,000, one of them listed since 19 Sep 2025 (over a year on the market - asking prices are not necessarily achieved). These are the only Berkeley new-build HOUSES on sale within 15 km of the site.

No prices published: the outline application (26/02199/OUT, ~2,200 homes in two neighbourhoods, Bromley Gate and Hayes Mead, about half affordable per Berkeley) is undetermined, and no Berkeley scheme is on sale in Bromley, Croydon, Lewisham or Bexley boroughs today. Older Berkeley house-led schemes in the area (e.g. Ryewood, Dunton Green, Sevenoaks, 2012-2015) are long sold out.
Berkeley currently advertises an 'Own New: Rate Reducer' mortgage-rate incentive on its site; asking prices here are before any incentive.
